gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-liter: Expressive from the first glyph, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of same width, while Liter's lowercase stands up with great vertical presence. Funnel Display is for statements; Liter is for wide-mouthed, no-contrast text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-michroma: Commanding in feel, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes with no hairline anywhere against a thick stem. And Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, so a paragraph moves at a slow, spacious pace.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-miriam-libre: Spaghetti-like, same-width strokes make Funnel Display instantly recognizable on sight. Miriam Libre, a sans-serif with wire-weight lines, a lowercase of cast-iron stature and generous s openings, keeps reading approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Spaghetti-like strokes of uniform width let Funnel Display make its statement loudly. Mochiy Pop One, a plain sans with letters hung like clothespins, is the one for steady text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mozilla-text: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes, its t crossbar and stem sharing a single width. But Mozilla Text, a sans with flared terminals and bold-looking lowercase, adds the texture contrast that makes this combination memorable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans: Funnel Display is best at statements, with signage-like plainness in every line weight and spaghetti-like strokes. But Noto Sans, with a wide-open c and lowercase filling most of the letter height, handles the reading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Flat, spaghetti-thin lines: Funnel Display draws single-weight strokes with commanding force, while Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Give its full c, s and z a generous body size.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-anato: The body text reads modern and neutral, its x-height near cap height, under Funnel Display's matched-arch r, n and m. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs adds outward-pointing terminals that make the whole combination feel open and forward.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-avest: Commanding from the first word, Funnel Display moves with one constant pen width throughout. And Noto Sans Avestan, a sans-serif with curve tips that never touch and a pronounced x-height, adds crisp clarity.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-bassa: Pure spaghetti lines: Funnel Display holds a unit-width stroke throughout, while Noto Sans Bassa Vah swallows line height with a huge midsection. Funnel Display announces, while that open-jawed c does the explaining.
